reviews.name: Rashaad M.
reviews.text: On January first I received a brief demonstration of a massage session, with Shanice of Queen Wellness, at The Wax Room. During the session my hips, shoulders and other areas of my body were stretched after having muscles warmed up. Little did I know this brief demonstration would undo years of limited mobility that had unknowingly became my normal! About ten to fifteen years ago I suffered dislocations to both shoulders at different times during sports activity, which I didn’t tell Shanice about. I didn’t think it mattered, but now I think about it that information was something I should have shared with her. I hadn’t noticed how limited I was until immediately after the session I realized both shoulders had more range of motion. Then while laying down with my arms raised flat above my head and bent at the elbow I didn’t have to slowly adjust my arms because my shoulders were aching. That’s when the Coming to America “ahh ha!” moment hit me of just how much that ONE SESSION impacted my quality of life! I am and will be a return customer and all being all a client eventually! Also, Shanice was answering questions keenly, providing immediate guiding instructions concisely to maximize efficiency of stretch while reducing risk of injury from improper following of her prompts during stretch. A session with Shanice should be a must for anyone with soreness or that’s just needing a good stretch.

reviews.text: My first wax room wax! They are located directly next door to Mr Pepe off Hull Street-I actually got myself lost only because the reviews had mentioned that it was hard to find (I was looking for like a side door-nope. It was right there. I made it way more complicated than it was). I arrived about 5 minutes early and my waxer, Alexis, was waiting for me. They ask that you take your shoes off when you enter, but do give you little  footies in case you forget to bring socks like I did. I’ve strictly been a Bombshell girl but they’re closed and a girls gotta do what a girls gotta do; the “procedure” is a little different but Alexis is AWESOME-she’s super friendly, easy to talk to, and I was shocked at how good of a job she did. Waxing hurts-you’re pulling hair out with hot wax so it never feels good, but she made it as pain free as possible. Pricing is extremely reasonable. Alexis was really good about explaining exactly what she was doing and making sure i was comfortable with the type of wax she was using, if I was okay with tweezing, etc. I had intended on making The Wax Room a temporary solution until Bombshell reopened but I REALLY like this place, and will book another waxing here. Both places are great but I like that they don’t try and sell you products or push other services-they just do a great job, with a super friendly person. I’ll probably let them have a try at my eyebrows next-I’m picky about them so that’s the real test. Thank you Alexis!
